summary: AirJoule Technologies subsidiary acquired all equity of Bitsink LLC, a South Carolina AI data-center cooling, power distribution and racking manufacturer, under a Sept 10, 2026 Purchase Agreement. Consideration was $18,000,000 cash plus 1,859,504 Class A shares issued via a concurrent Subscription Agreement, plus up to $40,000,000 of earnouts payable in Class A stock if 2027-2029 revenue targets are met. Seller Stanislav Dyshko accepted non-compete and non-solicitation covenants. Watch earnout dilution, share overhang and revenue-target achievability as the arbitrage angle.
